System

Parties, invitations, group credit and leadership

A minimal party/eligibility contract is needed before group combat rewards; full invite/leave/leader UI arrives in Phase 19. Party membership is a versioned social record, not a list invented independently by each zone server.

Scope and player interaction

A minimal party/eligibility contract is needed before group combat rewards; full invite/leave/leader UI arrives in Phase 19. Party membership is a versioned social record, not a list invented independently by each zone server.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase08committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Solo → InvitePending → Invited → Member → Leader → Leaving → Disbanded

WBP_Party observes results from URPGPartyComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_PartyPolicy_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
PartyId UUID; PartyRevision bigint; leader CharacterId
MemberCharacterIds and roles: bounded unique membership
InviteId, inviter/invitee, expiry and acceptance state
MaxMembers=4 initially; dungeon eligibility uses the same policy
CreditSnapshot: member IDs/revision at verified encounter event
CrossZonePresence: backend/social routing projection, not direct Actor references

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGPartyComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_PartyLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
InviteToParty(CommandId, TargetCharacterId) -> Invited|Blocked|PartyFull
AcceptPartyInvite(CommandId, InviteId) -> Joined|Expired|AlreadyInParty
LeaveParty(CommandId) -> Left|Disbanded
TransferPartyLeader(CommandId, MemberId) -> Updated|Forbidden
GetCreditEligibility(VerifiedEvent) -> Snapshot; server rules

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Phase 08 uses a service-created Party_AB fixture with two authenticated members; no public invitation UI is required for Slice A.
  2. In Phase 19 inviter selects an identity, server/backend validates block/membership/capacity and stores a short-lived invitation.
  3. Invitee accepts using their own authenticated session; backend atomically updates party membership/revision and invitation state.
  4. Zone servers receive safe membership/presence projections; party UI binds by CharacterId and resolves currently relevant actor pointers transiently.
  5. Combat/quest/dungeon systems snapshot eligible party members under their own proximity/contribution/share policies; joining after defeat does not retroactively obtain loot.
  6. Leave/disband/leader disconnect follows deterministic succession policy and invalidates stale pending instance reservations as required.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create PartyPolicy and DB_party_memberships/DB_party_memberships/DB_party_memberships records before group rewards. Seed Party_AB in the development service at Phase 08.
  2. Create WBP_Party with name/class/health/presence indicators, invite response, leave and leader controls; advanced UI integration is explicitly Phase 19.
  3. Reopen encounter and quest rules to use membership revision plus deliberate eligibility, not all nearby actors.
  4. Reopen dungeon allocator to reserve a coherent party roster, and chat routing to use authenticated party membership.
  5. Test cross-zone presence and one disconnected member without leaking private inventory or making a stale Actor pointer authoritative.

Reopen Phase08 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / Party_AB / Character_A / Character_B. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Two invitations accepted into different parties concurrently -> membership uniqueness allows one valid result.
Party fills before accept -> PartyFull.
Blocked player invites -> Blocked with privacy-safe response.
Leader disconnects -> declared succession after grace, not a permanently unusable party.
Member joins after kill -> no retroactive defeat reward.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Four members and a 60-second invitation TTL are proposals. Initial equal XP split applies only to eligible members; quests explicitly declare shared versus personal objectives.

Audit membership revisions and invitation results. Party UI supports keyboard/controller navigation and clear disconnected/out-of-zone status.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
